tooltip.essentialcraft5.elder_remnant.de.en: Kept in the core of a sealed vault, one for everyone who helped open it. Used to raise attunement stages.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.elder_remnant.de.zh: 封印宝库的核心里收着的，帮着解开封印的人每人一个。装备同调升阶要用。

message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.fir.en: First comes the flame, to light the sealed door.
message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.fir.zh: 先有烈焰，照亮封住的门。

message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.fir.en: Second comes the flame, to warm the cold steps.
message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.fir.zh: 其次是烈焰，焐热冰冷的石阶。

message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.fir.en: Third comes the flame, to burn the dust away.
message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.fir.zh: 再次是烈焰，烧尽积下的尘。

message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.fir.en: Last comes the flame, to melt the seal.

message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.wat.en: First comes the tide, rising under your feet.
message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.wat.zh: 先听潮声，从脚下漫上来。

message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.wat.en: Second comes the tide, drawing back to the deep.
Third comes the tide, washing the stones clean.
message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.wat.zh: 再次是潮声，把石头洗净。

message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.wat.en: Last comes the tide, to lift the seal.

message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.ear.en: First comes the stone, so it remembers you.
Second comes the stone, holding the ley line down.
Third comes the stone, laid as the threshold.
Last comes the stone, to set the seal down.

message.essentialcraft5.vault.riddle.air.en: First comes the long wind, clearing the sand.
Second comes the long wind, down the stairwell.
Third comes the long wind, carrying the echo off.
Last comes the long wind, to push the seal open.

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.rid.en: The words on this stele are worn too smooth to read.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.rid.zh: 碑上的字磨得太平，读不出来。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.key.en: The keyhole takes one Ley Crystal for each try. Once it goes in, it stays in.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.key.zh: 锁孔每试一次要一颗地脉结晶，放进去就不退了。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.key.en: There is already a Ley Crystal in the keyhole. Place the crystals on the pedestals in order.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.key.zh: 锁孔里已经有一颗地脉结晶了，去按顺序往祭座放晶石。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.key.en: The Ley Crystal sinks into the keyhole. Place elemental crystals on the pedestals in the order the stele gives.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.key.zh: 地脉结晶嵌进了锁孔。照碑文的顺序往祭座放元素魔晶。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.ped.en: This pedestal is carved with the %s mark. It takes %s.
This pedestal is carved with the %s mark and only takes %s.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.ped.zh: 这座祭座刻的是%s纹，只收%s。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.ped.en: The keyhole is empty. Put a Ley Crystal in the keyhole in the middle of the hall first.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.ped.zh: 锁孔还空着。先往前厅正中的锁孔放一颗地脉结晶。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.ped.en: %s more %s to go on this pedestal.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.ped.zh: 这座祭座还要再放 %s 个%s。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.fai.en: Wrong order. The seal lashes back at you. %s of the crystals you put in came back.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.fai.zh: 顺序错了，封印反噬了你。放进去的晶石退回了 %s 个。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.loc.en: You got this vault wrong %s times in a row. The seal won't answer you for about %s more minutes.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.loc.zh: 你在这座宝库连错了 %s 次，封印暂时不认你，还要等约 %s 分钟。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.loc.en: That is %s wrong answers in a row. This vault won't answer you for about %s minutes.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.loc.zh: 你连错了 %s 次，这座宝库约 %s 分钟内不再认你。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.sol.en: The seal opens and the door will stay open for %s seconds. You are now on this vault's list, so go in and right-click the core for your share.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.sol.zh: 封印开了，门会开 %s 秒。你记在了这座宝库的名单上，进去右键核心领你那一份。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.cor.en: The seal was never opened for you. You need to be in the hall when the riddle is solved to get a share.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.cor.zh: 封印没有为你打开过。碑文解开的那一刻人在前厅里，才领得到。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.cor.en: This vault has already given you your share.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.cor.zh: 这座宝库已经给过你一份了。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.cor.en: The vault core hands you your share.
message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.cor.zh: 宝库核心交给你一份东西。

message.essentialcraft5.sealed_vault.sea.en: The seal stones slide aside for you.
